functions.name: nie_formats_detect
functions.doc: Detects the format of a buffer from its leading bytes and returns its lowercase name, or "unknown". Free the result with nie_formats_string_free.

functions.name: nie_formats_crc32
functions.doc: CRC32 of a buffer as the game computes it for cfg.bin names.

functions.name: nie_formats_cfgbin_to_json
functions.doc: Decodes a cfg.bin (RDBN or T2B) into the tagged JSON form read by the typed tables of nie-data. NULL when the bytes are not a cfg.bin. Free the result with nie_formats_string_free.
